text: answer[mkt-1789369221106-e2f7c1]: Finland exists. It is a sovereign state in Northern Europe, a member of the European Union, the UN, and NATO, with a population of about 5.6 million. It has a functioning government, a currency (the euro), a distinct language, and internationally recognized borders with Sweden, Norway, and Russia. Its capital is Helsinki. The idea that Finland is a hoax is an internet meme, not a fact; it appears to have originated as a playful conspiracy theory, often used to test credulity or as satire. There is no credible evidence, geological, historical, or diplomatic, to suggest otherwise. Your friend can safely book a flight there.
